newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio official sees state debt deal by year's end.
newsitem.headline: Rio official sees state debt deal by year's end.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro Planning Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar said the restructuring of the state's 9.0 billion real debt will be resolved by the end of the year.
"By the end of the year it should be resolved," Alencar told reporters on Wednesday.

Rio de Janeiro is expected to sign a refinancing deal with the federal government under terms similar to deals reached with Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul and Sao Paulo states, which were required to pay off 20 percent of their debts through asset sales.
The remainder would be refinanced over 30 years, paying interest of six percent per year plus inflation.
The sell-off of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, scheduled for December 17, is part of the debt restructuring package.
Rio de Janeiro state owes some two billion reais to Banerj.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 55-21-5074151
